decisions.reason: Changing the fiat on-ramp provider does not alter secondary-sale royalty enforcement, pool destinations, or ticket-generation rules.
The source changes the fiat on-ramp from Stripe to Coinbase Commerce and does not change Brevo or transactional email delivery.
The provider change for fiat purchases does not alter SIWE authentication for crypto minting and NFT transfers.
The source does not change email magic-link authentication or its dashboard-access purpose.
The fiat on-ramp provider choice does not affect unauthenticated access to public APIs, leaderboards, or pool values.
The source changes a fiat payment provider and does not change the target blockchain network or deployment requirement.
Changing the fiat on-ramp provider does not alter the referral commission amount, recipient, trigger, or automatic payout mode.
The provider substitution does not change which ticket counters or permanent badges must appear in NFT metadata.
The source does not change the no-referral trigger, random NFT-holder selection, or reward components.
The fiat provider change does not alter ticket issuance, counters, eligibility windows, or post-draw reset behavior.
The source does not alter random winner selection, ticket weighting, or Small and Big Block eligibility.
The fiat on-ramp provider substitution does not change the Small Block prize amount, winner count, pool threshold, or royalty contribution rule.
